passives.name: KenpachiEquipment2Passive1
passives.description:
All of this unit's $FollowUpAttacks apply $Dismember to enemies. Whenever an ally in this unit's range is stunned, this unit will also be stunned

When this unit is stunned:
- Immediately $Cleanse the stun
- $FollowUpAttack ($KenpachiEVO_Skill4) at {1}% current damage

passives.name: KenpachiEquipment2Passive2
passives.description:
This unit won't accept any external support. After {1} $Takedowns or upon being stunned, this unit will enter $KenpachiTransformation for 15 seconds:
- Increase Damage by +{2}%
- Decrease SPA by -{3}%
- Apply $Dismember on every $Attack

$KenpachiTransformation entered through this passive:
- Increase $Dismember factor to {4}%
- Increase $KenpachiPassive1 size to {5}%
